notes:
The appointment letter now prints in the company's approved format. Every page carries the Sequence Surfaces letterhead; the key terms sit in a bordered table followed by the twenty-one numbered clauses; the HR and CEO signatures sit side by side at a size you can actually read, with the name and title centred under each; the employee's acceptance stays on the same page as the signatures; and Annexure I lays the pay package out in Part A, B and C tables with the Fixed CTC and Net Salary beneath. The wording is the approved letter's, word for word, and it is the default under Templates, so HR can still edit it there.

Logo & signatures has a new Letterhead slot at the top: the image printed across the top of every page of the appointment letter. The approved letterhead is built in, so nothing needs uploading unless the address changes. The company logo continues to head the offer and relieving letters and the payslip.

A letter issued from an employee's record now lists a medical allowance where it belongs, as an earning, rather than under deductions, so the net pay on Annexure I is right. Dates on letters read "7th July 2026" rather than "7th July, 2026".

Letters already issued are unchanged; issuing or re-issuing one produces the new format.

For everybody else nothing changes.
